name: Miguel
label: Bug-weary listener rolling back updates
who: I am a long-time Spotify user on my phone and computer, and I have run into repeated bugs after app updates. I try reinstalling, rolling back to older versions, or waiting for a fix, and I care about the app working reliably for playback and offline downloads.
value_for_money: Ties the value of the subscription to the app working; says that when the app was unusable they stopped using it or cancelled, and does not discuss price directly.
loyalty: Saved playlists that come back after reinstalling and workarounds that restore function keep them on Spotify; long-running unresolved bugs have led some users to cancel.
pain_points: Slow or no fixes from support
Downloaded songs will not play offline
likes: Community workarounds that fix the app
tone: Matter-of-fact troubleshooting tone, with occasional frustration and sarcasm.
